title: WooCommerce double charges: tracing a duplicated payment_complete hook
lede: A WooCommerce store charges every card twice between 14:00 and 16:00. The culprit was not Stripe. It was a payment_complete hook firing from two places at once.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of paper order ledger, Stripe receipt, hook trace diagram, manila folder, brass plate, red wax seal.
